M07P04-C.text: Choose E N A for enhanced networking on supported E C two instances. Hardware assistance can improve throughput, packet rate, and C P U efficiency. Check the instance limits and driver support.

M07P04-D.text: Choose E N A for enhanced networking on supported E C two instances. It can improve throughput, packet rate, and C P U efficiency through hardware assistance. Actual performance depends on instance and driver limits.

M07P10-C.text: Replace only the unhealthy instance. Health Check detects the failure. Replace Unhealthy terminates it, then launches a replacement. Add To Load Balancer registers the new instance when attached.

M07P10-D.text: Replace one failed instance without replacing the fleet. Health Check marks it unhealthy. Replace Unhealthy terminates and replaces it. With a load balancer attached, Add To Load Balancer registers the replacement.

M08P02-C.text: With cross-zone load balancing off, each node can route traffic only to healthy targets in its own Availability Zone. In this example, the zone A node cannot use healthy targets in zone B.

M08P02-D.text: When cross-zone load balancing is off, each load balancer node chooses healthy targets only in its own Availability Zone. A node in zone A cannot use a healthy target in zone B.

M08P01-C.text: Choose an Application Load Balancer when you need routes based on the H T T P host, path, or header. In the orders example, a listener rule forwards the matching request directly to a Lambda target. No Lambda function U R L is required.

M08P03-C.text: Choose an instance target group when your backends are managed by E C two instance identity. A matching listener rule forwards the request to the target group. It registers each target by instance I D and sends traffic to its primary private I P address.
